snippet.title: Infinity Blade II | PC Remaster (2025) | HD Gameplay
snippet.description:
Experience the iOS smash hit, Infinity Blade II, now available to play on PC fully compatible with mouse and keyboard controls. The following footage has been captured through on PC at 1080p 60fps.

Download and play for free here: https://archive.org/details/infinity-blade-ii-pc
